name: Speaker intro
description: Full-frame speaker introduction: photo (or initials), name, role, company and a short bio.

params.name: role
params.help: Title or role, e.g. Principal Engineer

params.name: company
params.help: Company or organisation, shown small above the name (empty: none)

params.name: bio
params.help: A short bio, 1 to 3 sentences; about 300 characters are shown

params.name: photo
params.help: Portrait: an https address or a data:image URI (empty: the initials in a circle)

example.name: Dr. Maya Chen
example.bio: Maya leads the real-time video team at Example Labs. She has spent ten years building streaming systems and loves making complex tech feel simple.

update.name: Jordan Patel
update.bio: Jordan shapes how millions of people use Example products every day.
